divergence_justification: The chartevents ETL casts source charttime through TIMESTAMPTZ at fhir_observation_chartevents.sql:9 and writes the irreversibly normalized value to Observation.effectiveDateTime at line 67. All 17 shifted source rows are explained: two re-key to candidate rows and 15 collide at 03:00, causing four MAX conflicts. The original wall time is absent from admissible FHIR fields—issued is storetime, and UUID inversion is forbidden—so attempt 0003 is faithful to the served representation.

reopen_history.reason: concept.sql recomputes the ETL's Observation.id UUIDv5 (SHA1 over a hardcoded namespace) to detect and undo a one-hour DST shift. Resource ids are opaque identity, so this is not a FHIR mapping and is refused by sql_lint (resource-id-inversion). No warehouse rebuild is needed: UTC-pinned reads remove the false Sydney effect, and comparator key_attribution exposes the residual upstream New York shift as an attributed divergence without inversion.
